name: Ludwig Ehlert
title: Senior Ecosystem Architect, Platform Strategy
headline: Applied AI, Agents & MCP · 10+ yrs Enterprise Pre-Sales
summary: Pre-sales architect with 10+ years helping large pharma/life-sciences and manufacturing enterprises turn new technology into production systems their people actually use. At Dataiku I helped build Dataiku Headless, an Anthropic-verified Claude Code plugin with a Python MCP server that lets coding agents work inside a governed data platform. Before that: applied-AI pre-sales for Swiss pharma (RAG, agents, automated LLM evaluation on customer data) and about eight years at Tableau/Salesforce on $5–10M ACV deals, including one of Tableau's largest European deployments (35k users). I build my own products with Claude Code and want to help Swiss and European enterprises deploy Claude safely and reliably, from first technical discovery to production.
